en: A sepia-toned postcard featuring a rustic wooded landscape with a traditional log building, a small outdoor dining area with empty wooden benches and tables, and several people seated by the building. The structure is nestled among tall trees on a forested hillside. There is handwritten text along the bottom and printed text with the word 'Eggenberg' and partial text 'Ein...' visible on the bottom right.
